# Mobal

> > Mobal provides travel connectivity solutions for Japan, specializing in pocket WiFi rentals, SIM cards, and eSIM services for tourists and business travelers.

Mobal offers ultra-fast 4G LTE connectivity across Japan through partnerships with major carriers including Softbank, Docomo, AU, and Rakuten. The company serves both individual travelers and corporate clients with no-contract, multi-network mobile internet solutions.

## Key Topics

- Pocket WiFi rental
- Japan SIM cards
- 4G LTE connectivity
- Softbank network
- Multi-carrier coverage (Docomo, AU, Rakuten)
- No-contract mobile plans
- Voice Lite SIM Card
- Voice+Data SIM
- eSIM options
- Corporate travel solutions
- Wi-Fi 6 (IEEE 802.11ax)
- WPA2-PSK security
- Travel WiFi hotspots
- Prepaid mobile services
- Business event connectivity

## Mobile Internet Solutions

- [Japan Pocket WiFi – Best on the Market | Mobal](https://www.mobal.com/pocket-wifi-japan): Japan Pocket WiFi rental with ultra-fast 4G LTE, Softbank network coverage
- [Japan SIM Card – Data & Phone Number Plans + Free Delivery | Mobal](https://www.mobal.com/japan-sim-card): Japan SIM cards with Voice Lite, Voice+Data, and eSIM options available
